entities.name: Fatty acid oxidation complex subunit alpha
observations: The 715-aa query has 79.6–79.8% identity and 99.6% query coverage to reviewed Shigella/E. coli homologs.
Homolog annotations describe enoyl-CoA hydration and 3-hydroxyacyl-CoA epimerase and dehydrogenase activities.
Homologs are annotated to fatty acid beta-oxidation and cytoplasm; these annotations support, but do not experimentally establish, the query's function and location.
